current_source.known_failure: stable_shuffle key includes base semantic state, making display order conditional on a target-generating factor

new_concept.name: CONDITIONAL_SUPPORT_CERTIFICATE_SEPARATED_FROM_ORDER_INVARIANCE_COVERAGE
new_concept.motivation: The current audit mixes two distinct requirements: (A) target non-predictability from visible nuisance variables and (B) exposure/generalization across presentation-order permutations. Full crossing all six orders is sufficient for both, but it is stronger and more expensive than is logically necessary for A.

variables.M: episode-local bijection from semantic decision class to output symbol
variables.K: other visible nuisance factors such as template/style/pool/family

new_concept.certificate: For each fixed nuisance signature N=(K,P,M,O) excluding semantic evidence, require equal support for all B values. Because phi_P is a permutation of the three decision classes and M is bijective, equal B support implies P(C|N)=1/3 and P(Y|N)=1/3 exactly in the empirical design. Therefore a nuisance-only lookup decoder is at exact 1/3 by construction for both class and symbol targets.
new_concept.critical_condition: O must not depend on B or any other semantic-evidence variable unless the full conditional support equality is still mechanically proven. RANDOMIZED is not enough; the schedule must be SEMANTIC_BLIND or otherwise support-certified.
new_concept.separate_order_invariance_requirement: Independence from nuisance does not prove robustness to unseen order permutations. Order invariance should be measured as a separate equivariance/generalization axis using held-out or fully crossed order interventions.

deterministic_static_reconstruction.scope: P1 TRAIN algebra reconstructed from current v3 loop structure; no model/runtime execution

current_v3_reproduction.signature_definition: template_id + polarity + S3 permutation + display_order, semantic scene/base excluded

base_blind_order_schedule_counterfactual.only_schedule_change: derive display order from template_id + pool + polarity + S3 permutation, explicitly excluding base semantic state
base_blind_order_schedule_counterfactual.interpretation: At logical schedule level, the critical conditional target leak disappears without increasing row count. This does NOT prove serialized-byte leakage freedom, model robustness, or training suitability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact per-signature three-class/three-symbol support is the minimal structural anti-shortcut invariant needed to eliminate the diagnosed v3 conditional nuisance lookup path.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Even with exact target support, other visible serialized features correlated with semantic evidence can preserve a shortcut; support certification over the chosen nuisance signature is insufficient.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminator: Run the existing rendered-prompt semantic ablation gate plus a serialized-byte nuisance decoder on a candidate schedule that passes exact support. Any above-chance result falsifies sufficiency of the chosen nuisance signature and requires expanding N.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Holding display order constant across the three semantic base states for each (template, polarity, mapping) cell removes the diagnosed target-conditioned scheduling leak at the same 144-row P1 TRAIN size.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The reduced schedule removes lookup leakage but underexposes order permutations, causing the model to overfit to mapping/order pairings and fail unseen-order binding.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminator: Do not train yet. Materialize two eval-only candidate schedules: base-blind minimal and full six-order cross. Verify exact support, then preregister a later matched-token pilot evaluating all six order interventions on family-disjoint templates/symbols once training authority and corpus admission exist.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dynamic binding promotion should require counterfactual order interventions at evaluation time because aggregate balance cannot establish a routing mechanism invariant to presentation order.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: A fully crossed training design makes a separate order-intervention evaluation redundant.
hypotheses.cheapest_discriminator: Freeze identical semantic/codebook episodes, permute only codebook display order, and require target equivariance under all six permutations; include template-OOD, symbol-OOD and joint-OOD families.

FULL_CROSS_REFERENCE.construction: 4 templates * 2 polarities * 6 S3 mappings * 6 display orders * 3 base states
FULL_CROSS_REFERENCE.benefit: maximal direct order exposure and exact conditional support
FULL_CROSS_REFERENCE.cost: 6x current P1 TRAIN row count before other curriculum expansion

BASE_BLIND_MINIMAL_SUPPORT.construction: 4 templates * 2 polarities * 6 S3 mappings * 1 display order shared across all 3 base states
BASE_BLIND_MINIMAL_SUPPORT.benefit: exact diagnosed conditional-support repair at current row count
BASE_BLIND_MINIMAL_SUPPORT.risk: not every mapping/template cell sees all order permutations during training

BASE_BLIND_MULTIORDER_INTERMEDIATE.construction: R semantic-blind display-order replicates per nuisance cell; each replicate contains all 3 base states
BASE_BLIND_MULTIORDER_INTERMEDIATE.benefit: preserves exact support while trading corpus size for order exposure
BASE_BLIND_MULTIORDER_INTERMEDIATE.selection_law: R must be chosen before model evaluation; final holdout must not select R

required_successor_gates_before_any_dire: exact three-class support for every nuisance signature excluding semantic evidence
exact three-target-symbol support for every nuisance signature
nuisance-only lookup accuracy exactly chance by construction where discrete support permits
conditional MI = 0 for certified discrete schedule or preregistered tolerance only after exact serialized expansion
rendered-prompt semantic-ablation gate on final bytes
serialized-byte nuisance decoder that sees every model-visible nonsemantic feature
no hidden metadata used as evidence of independence

external_research_delta.source: Wu, Geiger, Milliere (2025), How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?, arXiv:2505.20896
external_research_delta.finding: Transformers in the studied symbolic-program task passed through a shallow heuristic phase before learning a systematic binding mechanism; causal interventions localized routing behavior.
external_research_delta.implication: High aggregate accuracy or balanced labels cannot substitute for intervention-based binding diagnostics.

external_research_delta.source: Adnan et al. (2022), Monitoring Shortcut Learning using Mutual Information, arXiv:2206.13034
external_research_delta.finding: Mutual information is used as a diagnostic for shortcut learning under spurious correlations.
external_research_delta.implication: Retain MI as a diagnostic, but combine it with exact support/equivariance because low marginal MI can hide high-order conditional leakage, as v3 already demonstrated.

external_research_delta.finding: t-way combinatorial coverage formalizes whether combinations of factor values are covered and provides a coverage vocabulary when exhaustive crossing is impractical.
external_research_delta.implication: Treat order/template/mapping/polarity as explicit factors and report interaction-strength coverage separately from the target-independence certificate rather than conflating them.

novel_training_evaluation_rule: TARGET_INDEPENDENCE and NUISANCE_COVERAGE are separate axes. A schedule may pass exact conditional target support yet remain weak on order coverage; conversely, broad order coverage may still leak target if the schedule is semantic-conditioned. Trigger-2 should require both axes explicitly.
